sourceTitle: Chila Sandwich n Chila Pizza Toast
sourceText:
Chila Sandwich n Chila Pizza Toast
By: Usha Chowdhary Gupta
Published: Saturday, July 27, 2013 - 3:55am

Ingredients




For the Chila spread ..
1\2 Cup Besan / Bengal gram flour,
Salt, Turmeric powder and Red Chilly powder
to taste.
Few spoons Oil to drizzle.
For the stuffing ...
1\4 Cup Sweet Corn,
1 Onion cut finely,
2 Tbsp Capsicum cut finely,
Few drops Tabasco sauce,
2 Tbsp Tomato sauce,
Few pinch of Powder sugar,
Red Chilly powder, Pepper powder n Salt to taste.
Toasted bread ...
8 Bread slices cut in round shape, Butter applied on one side.
Mix Chutneys..
2 Tbsp Green chutney,
2 Tbsp Sweet chutney,
2 Tbsp Tomato sauce.
For the pizza toast ....
Grated Cheese..

Preparation

1 Mix all the chila batter ingredients. 2 Put a pan to heat and in little oil saute the stuffing 3 for few minutes. 4 Put a non stick tava to heat. 5 Spread a spoonful of chila batter on the round cut 6 bread on the side without butter. 7 Place it on the tava with the buttered side down. 8 Drizzle few oil drops n flip the side. 9 When begins to look golden brown spread a spoonful 10 of the stuffing n close with another toasted slice. 11 OR 12 For the pizza toast which is an open sandwich so 13 after putting the stuffing top it with cheese.
